description: This module provides functions for aligning and correcting subtitle entries using a Whisper transcript as a reference. It includes utilities for timestamp normalization, monotonicity enforcement, matching subtitles to transcript segments, text normalization, and comprehensive subtitle alignment logic.

methods.name: bool _is_blank(text: Optional[str])
methods.description: Checks if the given text is None or contains only whitespace.

methods.name: str _normalize_space(text: str)
methods.description: Collapses multiple whitespace characters into a single space and trims the text.

methods.name: float _overlap(a: Tuple[float, float], b: Tuple[float, float])
methods.description: Calculates the overlap duration between two intervals.

methods.name: float _interval_center(iv: Tuple[float, float])
methods.description: Returns the center point of a given interval.

methods.name: Any _get_seg_value(seg: Any, key: str, default: Any = None)
methods.description: Safely retrieves a value from a segment, handling dict-like objects and attribute access.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _to_seg_dict(seg: Any)
methods.description: Normalizes a segment into a dict with start, end, and text keys.

methods.name: None _ensure_monotonic(subs: List[Dict], min_gap: float = 0.02)
methods.description: Ensures a list of subtitle dicts have monotonic and non-overlapping start/end times.

methods.name: Optional[int] _match_transcript_segment( sub_iv: Tuple[float, float], transcript: List[Dict], )
methods.description: Finds the best matching transcript segment index for a subtitle interval based on overlap and proximity.

methods.name: Optional[int] _closest_transcript_index_by_time(point: float, transcript: List[Dict])
methods.description: Finds the transcript segment index closest to a given time point.

methods.name: List[Dict] _merge_adjacent_blanks(subs: List[Dict])
methods.description: Merges consecutive blank subtitles to reduce fragmentation.

methods.name: None _apply_text_from_transcript(sub: Dict, seg: Dict)
methods.description: Updates subtitle text from a transcript segment if missing or to normalize spacing.

methods.name: None _refit_times_to_segment(sub: Dict, seg: Dict)
methods.description: Refines subtitle timing to better match a transcript segment.

methods.name: List[Dict] align_subtitles( transcript: List[Dict], subtitles: List[Dict], *, cross_lingual: bool = False, preserve_subtitle_text: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Main function to align and correct subtitles using a Whisper transcript, adjusting timestamps and optionally updating text for consistency and timing accuracy.

ctags.signature: (seg: Any, key: str, default: Any = None)

ctags.signature: ( transcript: List[Dict], subtitles: List[Dict], *, cross_lingual: bool = False, preserve_subtitle_text: Optional[bool] = None, )
